Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 72: July 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #72 shipped to subscribers in June 2007 (bearing the cover date of July 2007 for Issue 72). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #72 arrived right at the start of the summer showcase season, offering playable 360 game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, and exclusive media content:

Overlord (dark fantasy action-adventure)
The Darkness (supernatural first-person shooter)
Dirt (Colin McRae off-road rally racing)
Tenchu Z (stealth ninja action)
Prince of Persia Classic (Xbox Live Arcade high-definition remaster)
PAC-MAN Championship Edition (Xbox Live Arcade arcade classic adaptation)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom dashboard themes, gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including early featurettes and trailers for Grand Theft Auto IV, BioShock, Halo 3, and Mass Effect, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
